experiment: VACASK NOT_GIVEN under a sweep and an alter (sp3/ENG/r_ng.sh)
result: a sweep of r over 1000/4000 gives -1e-3/-2.5e-4 and restores r = 2w; a sweep of w is followed; alter r=5000 gives -2e-4, then back
rules: §4.5 item 4 the NOT_GIVEN scheme: a dependent subckt parameter becomes overridable (parameters r=NOT_GIVEN, r__v=(r==NOT_GIVEN ? <default> : r)), so sub=X param=p sweeps and alters reach it and VACASK restores it after the sweep
